description:
Mission roller made with AOSharp SDK for Anarchy Online.  Contains features such as item searching with filtering, multi client rolling, fully afkable rolling and many others.

This plugin is part of my standalone toolkit (no building required) that can be downloaded here:
https://mega.nz/folder/XThTRBKD#w0JD-dp-Cxg9syfNEcIwiA

Preview video:
https://streamable.com/ja0gcs
name: Malis Mission Roller 2.0
